originality.rationale: The complete 2026 originating work supplies only the (4,2) Weierstrass normal forms, not a monodromy or branch-passport classification of the j-map; general quadratic-cover Galois theory gives an upper group but does not report the sharp elliptic-family polar locus. Three actual research-record comparisons and targeted public literature searches found no covering theorem for this exact stratification. An inaccessible general 2026 degree-four rational-map paper remains a priority risk.

value.rationale: The polar divisor defines an intrinsic symmetry-enhancement and branch-passport transition in a natural two-moduli rational-elliptic-surface family: a non-Galois D4 j-cover becomes a regular V4 cover with three branch values. This exact geometric stratification is motivated by the family and is not simply a root count or an unmotivated parameter slice.
